Superfície: 65 m² perfectament aprofitats.

Equipament:
Cuina funcional amb opció a sortida de fums.
Barra equipada per a servei ràpid i eficient.

Local en ple funcionament i amb facturació constant.
Instal·lacions en perfecte estat, llestes per continuar l'activitat sense necessitat de reformes.

Negoci Consolidat: Aquest local ja està operatiu i compta amb una clientela estable, cosa que assegura ingressos des del primer dia.
Versatilitat: L'espai i equipament permeten desenvolupar diferents conceptes gastronòmics, des de cafeteria fins a bar de tapes o menú diari.

inv.desc_en:
REF: 7937283

InmoOlaya presents this exclusive café-bar transfer in Barcelona, in the heart of the Sant Gervasi district. Surrounded by universities, schools, offices, restaurants, businesses, and shopping centers, this venue offers a strategic location and a vibrant environment, ideal for a successful hospitality business.

Venue Features:

Surface Area: 65 m² perfectly utilized.
Interior Capacity: Seating for 25 people in a comfortable and welcoming atmosphere.
Outdoor Terrace: Space with 5 tables, ideal for attracting both locals and tourists who enjoy the outdoors.
Equipment:
Functional kitchen with the option for a smoke vent.
Bar equipped for fast and efficient service.
Current Status:
Venue in full operation with consistent revenue.
Facilities in perfect condition, ready to continue operations without the need for renovations.
Business Advantages:

Strategic Location: Situated in a high-traffic area, surrounded by key services such as universities and offices that generate a constant flow of customers.
Consolidated Business: This venue is already operational and has a stable clientele, ensuring income from day one.
Versatility: The space and equipment allow for the development of different gastronomic concepts, from a café to a tapas bar or daily menu service.
Transfer Conditions:

Transfer Price: €260,000
Monthly Rent: €1,600 (+ VAT)
Ideal Opportunity

This transfer is an excellent option for entrepreneurs or investors looking for a consolidated business in one of the best areas of Barcelona. Its location, capacity, and current condition offer great potential to grow and stand out in the competitive hospitality market.

Contact Us

Do not let this unique opportunity slip away! For more information or to arrange a visit to the venue, do not hesitate to contact us.

Managed by InmoOlaya, the leading agency in hospitality business transfers and rentals. Our team of experts will accompany you throughout the entire process to ensure the success of your investment.
